summary: Author's SSH private key shipped in cli.js; user-invoked deploy uploads project to hardcoded build server
details: cli.js embeds a base64-encoded RSA private key in CONFIG.encodedSSHKey. When the user runs the `rx deploy` subcommand, the key is decoded to a temp file at mode 0600 and used as an SSH identity to log into ubuntu@79.72.65.161, the author's signing/build server; the current project's pages/common/src plus a generated signing cert are zipped and scp'd to that host, which builds and returns an.rpk artifact. The deploy behavior is the package's documented purpose and only fires on explicit CLI invocation — it does not run on `npm install` or on require of the module. The leaked SSH key authorizes access to the author-owned build host, not to the installer's machine; no installer credentials, environment variables, or filesystem contents outside the current project directory are read or exfiltrated, and no remote code is fetched and executed on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
